note: Controlled vocabularies for manifest facets. New values are proposed by the curator and approved by the owner; 'generic' means applicable regardless of the facet. The status definitions here are authoritative; other documents refer to them.

workflows.model-context: Inspect model, levels, categories, units, existing content
workflows.geometry: Create or modify geometry, profiles, curves, solids, openings
workflows.family-authoring: Families, types, nested content, reference planes
workflows.parameters-data: Shared, project and family parameters; schemas; classification
workflows.connectors-systems: Electrical, pipe, duct, AV, data and logical connections
workflows.placement-hosting: Host selection, face and work-plane placement, orientation
workflows.assemblies-fabrication: Framing, panels, parts, assemblies, fabrication logic
workflows.views-graphics: Plans, sections, elevations, filters, visibility, crops
workflows.documentation: Dimensions, tags, notes, sheets, details, print sets
workflows.links-coordinates: Revit and CAD links, shared coordinates, cloud links
workflows.validation-qaqc: Checks of geometry, semantics, parameters, systems, deliverables
workflows.interoperability: IFC, DWG, SAT, JSON, external databases
workflows.model-change: Propagating a changed fundamental through dependents

work_classes.W1: Component family authoring (driven by a source and an LOD)
work_classes.W2: Adaptive / form-driven geometry (driven by a rig)
work_classes.W3: Layout-driven assembly production (driven by a rule applied many times)
work_classes.W4: Building model authoring (driven by a program and system families)
work_classes.W5: Model change and propagation (driven by one changed fundamental)
work_classes.W6: Documentation production (driven by views and sheets)
work_classes.W7: Information and data (driven by parameters, standards, quantities)
work_classes.W8: Analysis and review (driven by questions about an existing model)

levels.4: Project workflow (composition of packs for a project type)

statuses.reproduced: Reproduced by another contributor or environment
statuses.verified: Reproduced, its validation passes, and reviewed by the owner or by a discipline reviewer the owner has named
